verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਸਿ ਘਰਿ ਸੂਰੁ ਪੂਰਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat liv gursikh sa(n)dh mile sas ghar soor poor nij ghar aae hai ||

en.bdb: The union of Guru and Sikh leads the Sikh to focus his mind on the divine word. The irha, pingla and Sukhmana enter the tenth door of the Sikh making him realise himself and granting him spiritual peace.

verses.gurmukhi: ਓੁਲਟਿ ਪਵਨ ਮਨ ਮੀਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਬੇਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਗ ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਉਲੰਘਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਸਮਾਏ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: oulaT pavan man meen tirabenee prasa(n)g tirakuTee ula(n)gh sukh saagar samaae hai ||

en.bdb: Practicing Naam Simran, the frolicsome mind becomes peaceful and crossing all hurdles gets engrossed in the realm of peace and tranquillity-the Dasam Duar. They are not to bear the torments of yogic practices.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਨ ਅਤੀਤ ਚਤੁਰਥ ਪਦ ਗੰਮਿਤਾ ਕੈ ਨਿਝਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਧਾਰ ਅਮਿਅ ਚੁਆਏ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: tiragun ateet chaturath padh ga(n)mitaa kai nijhar apaar dhaar amia chuaae hai ||

en.bdb: A practitioner of Naam detaches himself from the three pronged influence of mammon i.e. the worldly attractions and reach the stage of absolute.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਕਈ ਚਕੋਰ ਮੋਰ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਅਨੰਦ ਮਈ ਕਦਲੀ ਕਮਲ ਸੋ ਬਿਮਲ ਜਲ ਛਾਏ ਹੈ ॥੨੮॥
verses.translit_en: chakiee chakor mor chaatirak ana(n)dh miee kadhalee kamal so bimal jal chhaae hai ||28||

en.bdb: Just as Chakvi (Sun bird) seeing sun, Chakor (moon bird) seeing moon, rain bird and peacock seeing clouds get into wondrous stage of bliss, similarly a ·Gunnukh (Guru conscious person) who practices Naam Simran keeps progressing like a lotus flower in the water. (28)
